opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: up to £500,000; in special cases up to £750,000; most grants awarded below £300,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based organisations. Not funded: individuals without formal employment or contractual relationship with the host institution, projects led by unaffiliated individuals, schools or further education colleges, undergraduates or master's students, PhD fees or projects mainly supporting a PhD, establishment of academic posts, ongoing/rolling-out costs, dissemination-only projects, local charities or statutory replacement. Overseas organisations only in exceptional cases with strong UK-focused dissemination plans.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the five interconnected priority questions set out in the Strategic Review and aim to improve lives in the UK. There are two application deadlines a year (Spring and Autumn), with exact dates announced in advance.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants from diverse backgrounds are encouraged, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities. Partnership applications bringing together researchers and racially minoritised communities are strongly encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society in the UK. Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, covering all racial or ethnic groups living in the UK. 2026 priority theme: inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK. One deadline a year, in Autumn.
